# independence is the point — shared scaffolding can hide the same bug
# The stack convention these rows pin: args[0] is the TOP of stack, and a
# returned array is laid back in source order. Reading a row against a
# Forth reference means inverting that — `over` is ( a b -- a b a ), which
# is why the row below leaves 1 2 1 and not 2 1 2.
# `depth`, `pick` and `roll` are FULL-STACK words: the handler receives the
# whole resolved stack of the current paren scope and returns its complete
# replacement. The scope matters — a paren bounds what they can see.
